messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Yet, in the middle of math I wanted to put my head down and just fall asleep.

output.original_text: Yet, in the middle of math I wanted to put my head down and just fall asleep.
output.joy: Yet, in the middle of math, I felt so cozy that I wanted to put my head down and drift into a blissful nap!
output.sadness: Yet, in the middle of math, I felt so exhausted that I just wanted to put my head down and sink into a deep sleep.
output.fear: Yet, in the middle of math, I wanted to put my head down and escape into sleep, fearing I might not understand anything at all.
output.anger: Yet, in the middle of math, I was so frustrated that I just wanted to put my head down and crash into sleep.
output.surprise: Yet, in the middle of math, I was shocked to find myself wanting to put my head down and just fall asleep!
output.disgust: Yet, in the middle of math, I felt so nauseated that I wanted to put my head down and just fall asleep.
